completion_hook.py catches phase_gate.OverrideRefused, appends to refusals and re-raises. single_session_apply.py replaced the blockMessage/__name__ string check with `refusals and reason == 'on_complete_failed'`. Tests cover a renamed subclass (override_requires_human) and an impostor class named OverrideRefused (on_complete_failed, nothing written).

test_a_design_apply_the_gate_rejects_freezes_nothing pins that the run config stays byte-identical, but only for the first, retry-due rejection. The ask_human-terminal design apply goes through the same _gate_rejected early return, so the code is correct for both cases, but no test covers that case. Suggest parametrizing over rounds. The gate -> split read -> freeze-in-lock order and the separate-reads limit are documented in docs/hooks-and-pipeline.md.

loop_state.record_gate_terminal/gate_terminal_for are keyed on runId+task+version. _gate_rejected records the marker only when terminal == 'ask_human'. single_session_loop._awaiting_human runs inside resolve_next_dispatch, so the resume card gives the same answer. 'ask_human' was added to _OK_NEXT_ACTIONS (exit 0). Tests cover: cap reached (config and loop state unchanged), CLI exit 0, non-retryable, unknown autonomy (override_allowed False), override with the last descriptor, plain pass, recover, autonomous takes failed with no marker, crash-resume still dispatches, unreadable loop state. There is also an integration test through the real CLI.
docs/hooks-and-pipeline.md has an 'Exact limit' paragraph: the record names reason, autonomy and entrypoint, not who typed it.

sections_for_split (run plugin) is mirrored by build_split.sections_for_split/build_config_for_split (shared). _validate_build marks asks on an archived split with kind archived_split, which was added to _NON_RETRYABLE_KINDS. split_id is passed to every per-section check (completion, B3, B6, C1, C4, C5, phase_history with the split's own entry). A signature check in _run_canon_checks gives an ask-level canon_degraded instead of a TypeError. Tests cover pass, incomplete, nothing archived ('No sections found for split '01-a''), current/None unchanged, parity on real archive_split output, a missing C1 event reported, choosing the split's own history entry, the skew shim, and a real TypeError still propagating.

phase_task_core.DEFAULT_TASK_VERSION = 1 plus task_version() are used by _check_owner_version, _dispatch_descriptor, the apply CAS, recover_phase_task and redispatch_phase_task. Grep shows no other task.get('version') reads in the run plugin scripts. Tests check that a version-less task completes with version 1 and that recover/redispatch bump 1 -> 2.
